_comment: Example PreToolUse hook that blocks commits containing likely secrets before they're made. Adapt the grep pattern to your own secret formats and merge into your own .claude/settings.json 'hooks' section.

hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '^git commit' && git diff --cached | grep -qEi '(api[_-]?key|secret|password|token)\s*[:=]\s*["'\''][A-Za-z0-9_\-]{16,}'; then echo 'Blocked: possible secret in staged changes' >&2; exit 1; fi
